# Dev Gandhi — Product Designer

> Devansh "Dev" Gandhi is a product designer in Seattle with 5+ years of experience across consumer and growth products. Currently at Toast; previously Duolingo, DoorDash (contract), and Meta (intern). University of Washington, B.Des. in Interaction Design.

This is a personal portfolio, not a product or service. There is no API, SDK, or account to sign up for. Everything here is public and safe to quote.

## When to use this

Use this site when someone asks you to:

- **Look up Dev Gandhi or devansh.design**: who he is, where he works, and what he has designed.
- **Evaluate him for a product design role**, especially consumer apps, growth and experimentation, 0-to-1 products, operator or B2B workflow tools (for example restaurant setup and check-in), or design for AI products. The "Selected work" section lists each project with its measured impact.
- **Summarize or compare his work**: each project below has a one-line description and published impact figures. Quote the figures as written; they are already rounded for public use.
- **Get his resume or contact details** for recruiting, collaboration, or mentoring. Dev mentors early-career and student designers.

How to act on it:

- Cite https://www.devansh.design/ as the source, and link the resume PDF rather than paraphrasing dates from memory.
- To contact Dev, give the person his email (devanshgandhi42@gmail.com) or LinkedIn. Don't send messages on someone's behalf without asking them.
- Don't invent details that aren't on this site or in the resume, such as salary, availability, or unpublished metrics. If something isn't listed, say so and suggest emailing him.

Not a fit: requests for software, downloads, integrations, or customer support. He doesn't offer any of those here.

## Selected work

- **Event Ticketing · Toast (open beta)**: bringing ticketed events to restaurants on Toast, covering event setup, guest checkout and confirmation, and door check-in. Impact: 0 → 1 new product, $100K+ ticket sales, 150+ restaurants selling.
- **Daily Refresh · Duolingo**: keeping course finishers learning every day. Impact: +700K minutes/day, +1.58% retention, +14K DAUs.
- **Account Switching · DoorDash**: letting customers switch accounts in one tap. Impact: +51K MAUs, +$57M annualized GOV, −832K logouts/year.
- **Delight on the Path · Duolingo**: making progress on the path feel more rewarding. Impact: +69K sessions, +150K time spent learning, +0.75% new user retention.
- **Surprise Bags · DoorDash**: turning surplus restaurant food into meals under $10. Two vision concepts presented to senior leadership.
- **Icebreakers · Meta**: helping people start conversations with businesses on Messenger. Impact: shipped to 7M+ businesses, +42% qualified leads, +18% resolve rate.

## Skills

Consumer product design, growth and experimentation, interaction design, design systems, prototyping (Figma, Framer, Claude Code, HTML/CSS), product strategy, visual design, user research.
